name: @rizzy-vault/web
description: The web vault (ADR 0014; ROADMAP §4.2): React over packages/core, whose wasm core runs in one dedicated Worker (ADR 0013 §4). Built with Vite into dist/, which rizzy-server embeds with the embed-web feature (ADR 0010 §4).

scripts.e2e: cargo build --locked -p rizzy-server --bin rizzy-vault --features embed-web && playwright test
